summary: StageWise Strategies Corp. filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, disclosing a private placement of 1,000,000 common shares to its controlling shareholder (74.2% prior stake) at $0.25/share, $250,000 total. A $44,500 partial payment received; balance due by July 31, 2026. Shares restricted under Rule 144, sale exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D; no broker or advisor. This is a routine capital-raising by an issuer from an insider; not a special situation. No tender, activist, M&A, or restructuring event.
